1) Vendor to comply Technical Specification Annexure A as in GeM NIT. 2) QUALITY PLAN: As per Technical Specification Annexure A. 3) EVALUATION: - Tender shall be evaluated Item wise. 4) GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE: As Per GEM NIT. 5) Comprehensive Warranty: a) You shall submit a document with clear commitment for providing on -site com prehensive warranty of material/machine for 12 months from the date of successful co mmissioning of material/machine at the designated address & shall cover each and ever y parts of the machine/material including parts having limited life etc. and labor. The cost of deputation of expert(s) and any other associated expenditure to attend the rectification/fixing of fault shall be borne by you. f) In case your office is not able to rectify the fault and / or fails to rectify the fa ult within the period of three days, we have the right to demand for demurrag es because of loss to us due to “under repair” situation of the machine. 6) Security Deposit: Not Applicable. 7) The supplied material will be tested for performance before accepting/ clearance of the mat erials. 8) Deviations: Any Deviations w.r.t Technical Specification and NIT terms and condi tions is not acceptable. mission of Performance Bank Guarantee, issued by nationalized Bank by you o f equal value of 05% with validity of three years from the date of Installation & commissioning and completion of training of trainers, whichever is later. Pe rformance Bank Guarantee Format and list of consortium banks will be provid ed after the placement of Purchase Order. 10) Arbitration: Notwithstanding anything contained in any document whatsoever, all questions, m atters, disputes and claims relating to and arising out of this contract, shall be referred to sole arbit rator, who shall be appointed by the Head of the Unit, BHEL, Visakhapatnam at his sole discretion. Any waiver of time in respect of partia l installment shall not be deemed to be a waiver of time in respect of remaining deliveries. 12) BHEL Fraud Prevention Policy: The Bidder along with its associate/ collaborators/ sub-contra ctors/ sub-vendors/ consultants/ service providers shall strictly adhere to BHEL Fraud Prevention Pol icy displayed on BHEL website http://www.bhel.com and shall immediately bring to the notice of BH EL Management about any fraud or suspected fraud as soon as it comes to their notice." 13) Risk Purchase Clause: The delivery period stated shall be realistic and shall be strictly adhe red to. red Grievance Redressal Mechanism is in place to address any concerns or issues arising during the tendering process or in subsequent business deali ngs with the company.
